strongest_angle: Break down the Financial Industry Regulatory Authority National Financial Capability Study showing that 26 percent of Americans spend more than they earn, reversing a twelve-year trend.

key_facts.fact: The Financial Industry Regulatory Authority reported in its National Financial Capability Study that 26 percent of Americans spend more than they earn.
The Financial Industry Regulatory Authority Investor Education Foundation sixth wave of the National Financial Capability Study reveals a decline in U.S. adults' ability to make ends meet.
The amount of Americans who say they pay off their credit cards in full every month decreased by 6 percentage points since 2021 according to the Financial Industry Regulatory Authority.
